name: Case Assignment
definition: Represents the assignment of a case to a party. Assignment is a step in the overall process of managing a case.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identification of an assignment within a case.

Assigner.name: Assigner
Assigner.definition: Party that assigns the case to another party. This is also the sender of the message.

Assignee.name: Assignee
Assignee.definition: Party that the case is assigned to. This is also the receiver of the message.

CreationDateTime.name: Creation Date Time
CreationDateTime.definition: Date and time at which the assignment was created.
